nodes.name: animation-derived-value.md
nodes.summary: Vercel React Native best-practice rule (MEDIUM impact) recommending useDerivedValue over useAnimatedReaction when deriving a Reanimated shared value from another, for cleaner, dependency-tracked code.

nodes.name: animation-gesture-detector-press.md
nodes.summary: Vercel React Native best-practice rule (MEDIUM impact) advising use of GestureDetector with Reanimated for animated press states to keep press feedback on the UI thread.

nodes.name: animation-gpu-properties.md
nodes.summary: Vercel React Native best-practice rule (HIGH impact) instructing developers to animate transform and opacity instead of layout properties so animations are GPU-accelerated and avoid layout recalculation.

nodes.name: design-system-compound-components.md
nodes.summary: Vercel React Native best-practice rule (MEDIUM impact) recommending compound components over polymorphic children props for flexible composition and a clearer component API.

nodes.name: fonts-config-plugin.md
nodes.summary: Vercel React Native best-practice rule (LOW impact) recommending Expo config plugins to load custom fonts natively at build time instead of async runtime loading, so fonts are available at launch.

nodes.name: imports-design-system-folder.md
nodes.summary: Vercel React Native best-practice rule (LOW impact) requiring UI primitives to be imported from a central design-system folder rather than directly from the underlying library, enabling global changes and easier refactoring.

nodes.name: js-hoist-intl.md
nodes.summary: Vercel React Native best-practice rule (LOW-MEDIUM impact) advising Intl formatter instances (e.g. Intl.NumberFormat) be hoisted out of render to avoid expensive object recreation on every render.

nodes.name: list-performance-callbacks.md
nodes.summary: Vercel React Native best-practice rule (MEDIUM impact) recommending callbacks used by list items be hoisted to the root of the list component to reduce re-renders and speed up list rendering.

nodes.name: list-performance-function-references.md
nodes.summary: Vercel React Native best-practice rule (CRITICAL impact) explaining that list virtualization relies on stable object/function references, and how unstable references break renderItem, keyExtractor, and other list callbacks.

nodes.name: list-performance-images.md
nodes.summary: Vercel React Native best-practice rule (HIGH impact) recommending compressed/resized images inside list items for faster load times and lower memory usage.

nodes.name: list-performance-inline-objects.md
nodes.summary: Vercel React Native best-practice rule (HIGH impact) warning against inline object/array literals in renderItem, since they defeat memoization and cause unnecessary re-renders of list items.

nodes.name: list-performance-item-expensive.md
nodes.summary: Vercel React Native best-practice rule (HIGH impact) recommending list item components stay lightweight, moving expensive computation and hooks out of frequently re-rendered items to reduce scroll render time.

nodes.name: list-performance-item-memo.md
nodes.summary: Vercel React Native best-practice rule (HIGH impact) advising list items receive primitive props rather than objects so React.memo comparisons work effectively and avoid unnecessary re-renders.

nodes.name: list-performance-item-types.md
nodes.summary: Vercel React Native best-practice rule (HIGH impact) recommending explicit item-type identifiers for heterogeneous lists (e.g. with FlashList/LegendList) to enable efficient view recycling and reduce layout thrashing.

nodes.name: list-performance-virtualize.md
nodes.summary: Vercel React Native best-practice rule (HIGH impact) recommending any list use a proper list virtualizer (FlatList/FlashList/LegendList) instead of ScrollView + map, for reduced memory usage and faster mounts.

nodes.name: monorepo-native-deps-in-app.md
nodes.summary: Vercel React Native best-practice rule (CRITICAL impact) requiring native dependencies to be installed directly in the app directory of a monorepo, since autolinking requires them to be resolvable there.

nodes.name: monorepo-single-dependency-versions.md
nodes.summary: Vercel React Native best-practice rule (MEDIUM impact) recommending a single version of each dependency be enforced across a monorepo's packages to avoid duplicate bundles and version conflicts.

nodes.name: navigation-native-navigators.md
nodes.summary: Vercel React Native best-practice rule (HIGH impact) covering native stack and tab navigators, and native header options, for native performance and platform-appropriate navigation UI; the longest rule in the pack with dedicated stack/tab navigation sections.

nodes.name: react-compiler-destructure-functions.md
nodes.summary: Vercel React Native best-practice rule (HIGH impact) recommending functions be destructured early in render bodies so the React Compiler can produce stable references and avoid unnecessary re-renders.

nodes.name: react-compiler-reanimated-shared-values.md
nodes.summary: Vercel React Native best-practice rule (LOW impact) requiring Reanimated shared values be accessed via .get()/.set() rather than .value, since the direct .value accessor is incompatible with the React Compiler.
